relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: This interaction led to the inhibition of interleukin-15 expression in CAFs, suppressing the infiltration and cytotoxic function of natural killer (NK) cells and thereby promoting PDAC progression and cancer pain.

relationships.subject: nociceptor neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings highlight the crucial regulation of NK cells by nociceptor neurons through interaction with CAFs in the development of PDAC.

relationships.subject: nociceptor neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we further demonstrated that within the tumor microenvironment of PDAC, nociceptor neurons interacted with cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) through calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) and nerve growth factor (NGF).

key_findings: Nociceptors interact with CAFs via CGRP and NGF, suppressing IL-15 and NK cell infiltration/function, promoting PDAC and pain.
Nociceptive innervation correlates negatively with NK infiltration and positively with pain intensity in patients.
